categories.main_business_segments: Greenworks (Jiangsu) Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the new energy garden machinery industry, focusing on the research, design, manufacturing, and sales of lithium battery-powered garden tools and equipment. Their product portfolio includes lawn mowers, pressure washers, blowers, chainsaws, robotic mowers, and commercial ride-on mowers. The company also provides ODM services for international brands and has a diversified sales channel including retail, e-commerce, and professional distributors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary lithium battery technology with five voltage platforms (24V, 40V, 60V, 80V, 82V) covering garden tools, power tools, and mobility products. It has strong R&D capabilities with over 1,984 patents, including 394 invention patents, focusing on electric motor control, battery management, and AIoT integration. Manufacturing is vertically integrated with over 80% core components designed and produced in-house, supported by intelligent manufacturing systems and global production bases in China, Vietnam, and the USA.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Greenworks serves a broad customer base including household consumers, professional landscaping companies, and international retail giants. Its products are sold through over 12,000 global retail stores and major e-commerce platforms like Amazon. Key markets include North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific, with a focus on high-end commercial and residential garden machinery users.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with manufacturing facilities in China, Vietnam, and the United States. Its sales and service networks cover North America, Europe, Southeast Asia, Australia, and other regions. It has established localized operations and customer support centers in strategic markets such as the USA, Canada, Germany, and Sweden.
categories.supply_chain_position: Greenworks operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, encompassing product design, component manufacturing, assembly, and direct sales. It controls over 80% of its core component production, including battery packs, motors, and controllers, enabling vertical integration and supply chain resilience.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes a 'technology-led, brand-driven' strategy, focusing on continuous innovation in lithium battery technology, AIoT integration for smart garden equipment, and expanding its product matrix. R&D efforts target intelligent upgrades, autonomous operation, and commercial-grade equipment development. It also prioritizes global market expansion, supply chain digitalization, and sustainable, zero-carbon solutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of self-branded and customer-branded garden machinery. The company also earns income from ODM manufacturing services for international brands. Sales channels include retail stores, e-commerce platforms, and professional distributors, with a growing contribution from direct online sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Greenworks positions itself as a global leader in lithium battery-powered garden machinery, uniquely offering a full range of commercial lithium battery garden equipment. It competes against traditional European and North American brands in the high-end market and rapidly growing Chinese manufacturers leveraging cost and technology advantages. Its strong brand presence in North America and diversified product portfolio provide competitive differentiation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Greenworks achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 5.43 billion, representing a 17.52% year-over-year increase, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 87.89 million, up 118.53%. The company has shown a steady growth trajectory since 2021, with significant expansion in self-branded product revenue and improved profitability. It maintains a robust asset base of over RMB 9.4 billion and continues to invest heavily in R&D and global expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Greenworks offers a comprehensive lithium battery ecosystem with interoperable battery platforms across a wide product range, reducing customer costs and enhancing user convenience. Its products combine high performance, environmental sustainability, and intelligent features such as AI navigation and zero-turn technology. The company’s vertical integration, global manufacturing footprint, and strong brand reputation deliver reliable, innovative, and eco-friendly garden machinery solutions tailored for both residential and professional users.
